title: Generics — quick overview
rememberThis: List<T> is type-safe and does not box int. ArrayList stores object and boxes.
C# generics reify types: List<int> is a constructed type at run time, unlike Java erasure or TS erasure.
Constraints tell the compiler what T can do. notnull warns; most others error.
out T is covariance (IEnumerable). in T is contravariance (Action). IList<T> is invariant.
A Result<T> or TryGet pattern beats returning null from Get<T> for cache misses.
bullets: Open generic: List<T>. Closed generic: List<string>.
new() cannot combine with struct/unmanaged and cannot construct types with required members.
allows ref struct is an anti-constraint so T can be Span-like (module 17).
TS variance is structural and mostly bivariant on callbacks in practice; C# variance is declared and checked.
Dictionary<TKey, TValue> is the everyday two-parameter generic.
